title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, NFTs, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: MegaETH scraps $1B plan after technical failures derail sale
summary: Multiple technical failures during MegaETH’s pre-deposit phase pushed the raise beyond its limit and forced the team to halt the sale.

title: Bitcoin wavers under $88K as traders brace for $14B BTC options expiry
summary: Bitcoin price stalled as traders consider the impact of Friday’s $14 billion options expiry, but data does show some bullish traders positioning for higher prices.

title: Acting CFTC chair seeks CEOs for ‘innovation council,’ citing crypto
summary: The US CFTC opened nominations for a CEO-led advisory group that will help shape policy on crypto, prediction markets and other emerging products.

title: South Africa’s central bank flags crypto, stablecoins as financial risk
summary: The bank cited increasing trading volume and the number of users among large exchanges, as well as gaps in South Africa’s regulatory framework on crypto.

title: How Zcash went from low-profile token to the most-searched asset in November 2025
summary: Halving math, shielded growth and NU6.1 governance turned Zcash from a low-profile relic into November’s most-searched crypto.

title: Paxos acquires Fordefi to power stablecoin, tokenization infrastructure
summary: The addition of Fordefi’s MPC wallet infrastructure broadens Paxos’ regulated capabilities for custody, tokenization and institutional onchain operations.

title: Polymarket wins regulatory approval to operate US trading platform
summary: The approval came as the US Senate is expected to soon vote on prospective CFTC Chair Michael Selig as a replacement for acting chair Caroline Pham.

title: Bitcoin short-squeeze to $90K possible as funding rates turn negative
summary: Negative Bitcoin funding rates and large short liquidity zones could be a sign that a short-squeeze to $90,000 and higher could be on the cards.

title: Why the SEC’s new guidelines could speed up the approval process for new crypto ETFs
summary: New SEC rules could reshape the crypto ETF landscape by speeding up approvals, reducing the shutdown backlog and giving issuers a clearer and faster path to market.
